raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React. Seeking a Software Development Engineer II role to apply strong fundamentals in backend systems, APIs, and testing.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Developed a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain 3+ years of professional software development experience at a company; internships and academic projects do not count toward this requirement.
Study and apply design patterns (e.g., Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy) in your production code and document them in project READMEs or code comments.
Learn distributed systems concepts (e.g., eventual consistency, partitioning, replication, consensus) through courses or by contributing to open-source projects that use them.
Participate in code reviews on real projects; both reviewing others' code and receiving feedback on your own will strengthen this skill.
Build a project that demonstrates scalability or handles concurrent requests, and measure performance improvements.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the SDE II role requires 3+ years of professional experience and demonstrated expertise in distributed systems, design patterns, and code review. Focus on landing a junior/entry-level SDE I role first to build the required experience and depth.
